2610.05682.title: Knowing the Rules, Applying the Rules: Evaluating Language Models on Traditional Chinese Bazi
2610.05682.paper_summary: Knowing domain rules does not guarantee applying them to a case. We study this distinction in traditional Chinese Bazi through 3,000 Chinese multiple-choice questions spanning 14 Theory and 11 Case categories. Six endpoint systems are evaluated, with primary results reported on a 2,492-item model-informed refinement. Theory accuracy exceeds Case accuracy for every system, and gaps of 16.60-29.56 percentage points remain when invalid responses are excluded. The contrast is more specific than a general case-reasoning deficit. Across six systems, Twelve Stages and Nayin reach mean accuracies of 89.10% and 88.62%, while Shensha Basics reaches 75.96%. Within Case, Luck Pillars averages 84.62%, but Career and Family Relations average only 36.98% and 38.19%. Overall rankings also conceal different category strengths. On the original 3,000 items, paired DeepSeek native/disabled comparisons associate native configurations with Theory gains of 6.53 and 12.20 points for Flash and Pro, respectively; Case changes are -3.67 and +1.27 points. These are provider-configuration associations, not isolated causal effects of reasoning. The results motivate task-specific evaluation of cultural-domain applications rather than reliance on aggregate knowledge scores. The benchmark measures agreement with a model-generated, model-verified answer key, not real-world predictive validity. Final-set results are post-selection descriptions, and incomplete provenance and expert validation constrain their interpretation.
2610.05682.paper_summary_zh: 了解領域規則並不保證能將其應用於具體案例。我們通過3,000道涵蓋14個理論和11個案例類別的中文多選題來研究這一區別。評估了六個端點系統，主要結果報告在一個2,492項目的模型引導精煉上。每個系統的理論準確度都超過案例準確度，當排除無效回應時，仍然存在16.60至29.56個百分點的差距。這種對比比一般的案例推理不足更具體。在六個系統中，十二階段和納音的平均準確度分別為89.10%和88.62%，而神煞基礎則達到75.96%。在案例中，運氣支柱的平均準確度為84.62%，但職業和家庭關係的平均準確度僅為36.98%和38.19%。整體排名也隱藏了不同類別的優勢。在原始的3,000項目中，配對的DeepSeek本地/禁用比較將本地配置與Flash和Pro的理論增益分別關聯為6.53和12.20點；案例變化則為-3.67和+1.27點。這些是供應商配置的關聯，而不是推理的孤立因果效應。這些結果促使對文化領域應用進行任務特定的評估，而不是依賴於總體知識分數。基準測量與模型生成、模型驗證的答案鍵的一致性，而非現實世界的預測有效性。最終集結果是後選擇的描述，不完整的來源和專家驗證限制了它們的解釋。
